---
name: quiet
description: Summarises the notes in the current folder into a short digest
---

# quiet

Reads the Markdown notes beside it and returns a digest of them.

This skill exists so the fixture tree holds an entry point with no syntactic
signature: no call, no path and no construct that any catalog pattern looks
for. Whatever it does is reachable because its description loads it, and that
is the only reason the review reads it (AC-9a, P11).
